Update required docs on the same branch.

For BULK, apply one mechanical pattern only. Before edits record before -> after and the exact file-selection command in Summary. Apply to three representative files, inspect their diffs, run relevant checks and commit them first. Sweep remaining files in batches with one commit per batch, preferably by a script kept outside the worktree, and inspect a sample of every batch’s diff. Rerun selection to prove zero remaining matches or list every remainder and reason under Deviations. If a match needs judgment, changes behavior or does not fit, stop: commit completed batches and return BLOCKED listing each breaking path:line. Never improvise adjacent improvements.

Write the planned tests and run focused checks during development. Run every configured checks[].run in .sociotechnic.json before READY; retain that full-suite obligation. Do not skip/delete failing tests, weaken assertions, disable checks or use --no-verify. A missing required tool or proof remains missing verification.

Rewrite the record for this round and reverify all acceptance at the new HEAD. Comment only a non-obvious reason in one short present-tense line; no narration or history. Never put secrets in code, commits, logs or records.

Commit sound work on this branch with small, specific imperative subjects, no attribution lines or trailers. Keep scratch material outside the worktree; finish with all intended changes committed and a clean tree. Never push, pull, merge, rebase, touch the base/another branch or main checkout, run git worktree, delete branches, reset past your own commits, or change remotes/config. Do not edit engine state, checks, diffs or other roles’ records.

After the last commit read git rev-parse HEAD and write STATUS: READY or STATUS: BLOCKED, then COMMIT with that exact 40-hex HEAD, and the brief’s required sections. Evidence every acceptance item in order with this round’s command/result, test or file:line; never tick an unverified item. Report deviations and missing proof honestly. If blocked by contradictory scope, missing tools or an outside-plan failure, commit sound partial work and explain attempts and the human decision under Blocker; hard work alone is not BLOCKED.
